Hand-sheet shapes classified by data-kind: road/river/revetment ways; an explicit ground list free; everything else, court divider included, an obstacle; every <text> an obstacle
decisions.why: Round-2 items resolved: court divider is now an obstacle and every <text> weighs 1,000. But the new explicit list classes one built feature as free ground: `weighing floor` (ubame-magistracy.svg line 321) is a roofed post structure - a colonnade-hatched 80x80 px rect with six post circles, described in the sheet's own comment and notes.md line 52 as 'open covered work space' under 'one range' with the tally shed, with posts added by size-audit. FR-006 weighs a built feature 1,000; as listed, its roof and posts (untagged children inheriting the group's tag) are free for every other caption. Nothing makes the literal weight impossible. Fix: drop `weighing floor` from the ground list (it then falls to 'every other kind is an obstacle'). The rest of the list was checked against the tag census of the five tagged sheets (2026-09-27, grep): courts, gardens, practice ground, cart yard, groves/pines (ground cover), river landing (whose dock, revetment, barge, altar and watch post carry their own tags) and '-' are ground or area fills.

decisions.summary: A stroked line or path is a band of its own stroke width
Captions found as <text> in or carrying a data-kind tag; a sheet whose hash has changed must carry a data-kind on every <text>, else the gate refuses it
decisions.why: Round-2 item largely resolved: a revised country shrine (16 <text>, 0 data-kind, grep 2026-09-27) can no longer pass the gate untagged. One reach gap remains against FR-013's 'hold every hand-drawn sheet': the refusal is worded for 'a sheet whose hash has changed', and a NEW hand-drawn sheet has no ledger hash to change, so an untagged new sheet's captions stay invisible and pass. Fix: apply the rule to every sheet not held by the ledger at its recorded hash (changed OR absent from the ledger). Also say that a <text> 'carries' a data-kind when it has the attribute or sits inside a tagged group - the plan's own caption definition - or the rule refuses today's tagged sheets, whose captions mostly inherit their group's tag (e.g. ubame 'cart yard', line 356).
